facts.fact: Askanwi reports UNDP and the Independent Electoral Commission launched e-Monitor Plus on 13-15 October 2026, a platform combining artificial intelligence with human verification to monitor online misinformation, disinformation and hate speech ahead of the 5 December 2026 election.

systems.owner: UNDP with the Independent Electoral Commission
